rows.Origin:
Bred by Christopher H. Warner (United Kingdom, before 2014).
Introduced in Australia by Roses and Friends Archive of closed nursery in 2015.
Introduced in New Zealand by Tasman Bay Roses / Cornerstone Roses in 2015 as 'For Your Eyes Only'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink, apricot shading, darker center, ages to lavender . Mild fragrance. Single (4-8 petals) bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm). Width: 1' to 16" (30 to 40cm).
rows.Patents:
Australia - Application No: 2015/234 on 25 Aug 2015 VIEW PBR PATENT
Trade reference: For your eyes only

Application withdrawn on January 31, 2017. New Zealand - Patent No: 33252 on 13 Jul 2018
Application No: ROS1040 on 29 Jun 2016
